newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch GSA association aims for ISO 9002 in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Dutch GSA association aims for ISO 9002 in 1997.

text.p: DAGSA, the Dutch association of general sales agents, hopes to obtain the ISO 9002 quality certificate later this year, its chairman Fred Veenendaal told Reuters.
"The move is an unusual one because the association is trying to get the certificate as an association which means each member has to meet the same standard," he added.

Commenting on why the association decided to seek certification, he said: "Our competition comes from the airlines and in the future it will be even more important that everybody knows that we all have the same quality standards. The market will know exactly who we are and how we work."
The gsas' hope to gain the certificate in September.
DAGSA has eight members comprising:Air Cargo Trader, Inter Aviation Services, Zygene, Air Agencies Holland, Air Support, Active Airline Representatives and VIA. Veenendaal is also chairman of VIA.
